nodes.name: Attacker
nodes.description: Threat actor conducting reconnaissance and exploitation.

nodes.name: Establish and enumerate PostgreSQL servers
nodes.description: Identify PostgreSQL servers that may be exposed or improperly configured.

nodes.name: PostgreSQL configuration issues
nodes.description: Identify PostgreSQL instances with exploitable access-control or network-allowlist settings.

nodes.name: Trust authentication enabled
nodes.description: PostgreSQL assumes that an established connection is authorized without requiring authentication.

nodes.name: Overly broad permitted IP range
nodes.description: A broad client IP range permits the attacker's source IP address to connect.

nodes.name: Unauthorized PostgreSQL connection
nodes.description: The attacker connects to PostgreSQL without valid credentials because the trust and network-access conditions are satisfied.

nodes.name: Database access
nodes.description: The attacker obtains access to the PostgreSQL database.

nodes.name: Identify container images
nodes.description: Locate container images and applications deployed within them.

nodes.name: Search for application security flaws
nodes.description: Search containerized applications for vulnerabilities that could provide remote code execution.

nodes.name: WordPress
nodes.description: Application searched for an exploitable security flaw.

nodes.name: Liferay
nodes.description: Application searched for an exploitable security flaw.

nodes.name: PHPUnit
nodes.description: Application or component searched for an exploitable security flaw.

nodes.name: Oracle WebLogic
nodes.description: Application server searched for an exploitable security flaw.

nodes.name: Remote code execution vulnerability
nodes.description: An exploitable vulnerability in one of the targeted applications allows remote code execution.

nodes.name: Exploit remote code execution vulnerability
nodes.description: The attacker exploits the identified vulnerability to execute code in the container or on the associated server.

nodes.name: Push attacker payload
nodes.description: The attacker delivers or executes a payload after obtaining code execution.

nodes.name: Server access through containerized application
